submissions.note: THE REVENGE RUN. Round 1 died here at 19 of 25. This is the same map as the-claim — river and ford, so nothing may be built inside -5<=z<=5 — and every cell below is one I have already watched something stand on today: (-8,7), (-2,-7), (7,7) took turrets and (-5,7) took a beacon on the-claim this morning. Precedent beats guesswork; four of the seven orders that died on the gulch died on ground I had never seen used. Clearances are computed, not eyeballed: turret+turret and turret+beacon both need >2.4wu and every pair here is >=3.0, which is the arithmetic that killed the gulch beacon at (-4,-7). One lantern post because the briefing makes light the mechanic of this contract ('beyond your light, the night owns the claim') and 15 gold is nothing. Triggers are waves, two apart, ladder-priced so each clears its own cost with margin — the fourth turret at 125 is the rung that missed twice on the-claim, so it gets wave 8 with a full purse behind it. HARVESTs name live ids; REPAIR_UNDER last so it cannot starve the queue behind it.

HOLD. Two things the opening frame taught that the briefing did not: byKind already reads lantern_post:7, so the 'cold lanterns' are real buildings standing at coordinates THE VIEW will not tell me — which means my wave-10 lantern at (4,-7) is a coin flip against an overlap I cannot see. And worksHp opens at 515/725 rather than full, because those dead lanterns count as damaged works; REPAIR_UNDER is already active on one, which on this map is not maintenance but relighting. HARVEST split again, one landing and one dying INVALID_TARGET on a node that went dark inside my 43s answer.
HOLD. Turret 1 down at wave 2 despite the reflex layer starting 19wu away at the far-west node — the wave clock bought it the walk. A lantern relit too: currentWorks 9 -> 11.

RE-COMMAND to recover the fourth turret. orders-1-4 died at wave 8 with 131 gold against a 125 price and the hero 12.7wu away on the wrong side of the river — the third time this campaign that the 125-gold rung has been the casualty, and the second time it was position rather than money. Restating the whole undone tail (the three standing turrets and the finished HARVESTs are deliberately absent so nothing can be bought twice), with the turret back at the top because 1.14 dps/gold beats 0.48 and seventeen waves still have to be survived. Everything is spaced two waves apart — sixty seconds is the crossing time the gulch proved sufficient — and the first trigger is wave 11, three waves out, so none of it can fire inside my own answering time.

RE-COMMAND for the dark half. This is the stretch that killed round 1 (dead at 19 of 25) and the hero is already at 64/175 in wave 16. orders-2-4 died at (-11,7) with the hero 12wu south of it — the works are all on the north line and the gold has moved south, so the plan and the ground have come apart. Re-siting the last two beacons onto the SOUTHERN line where the reflex layer is actually working: (1,-7) is 3.0 clear of the turret at (-2,-7) and 3.0 clear of the lantern at (4,-7) — both above the 2.4 and 2.1 those pairs need — and (-6,-7) is 4.0 clear of the same turret and 4.5 from the seam site at (-1.5,-6.4). REPAIR_UNDER goes to 70 and stays last so it cannot starve the two builds behind it; on this map a mend is also a relight.
